stemKinds.description: The infinitive minus its class ending (parler → parl, finir → fin, vendre → vend). Default. Spelling rules are applied to it before any tense suffix is added.
infinitiveStem with a per-class suffix re-attached after spelling (futur/conditionnel: parl+er, fin+ir, vend+r → parler-ai, finir-ai, vendr-ai; achèt+er-ai).
Another conjugated form of the same verb with a suffix stripped (not used by the regular French classes; irregular verbs are explicit).

passeCompose.note: with être the participle agrees: masculine forms shown (allé / allés); feminine -e not shown; reflexive verbs are not covered

spelling.when: stem ends in c and the ending starts with a or o (commencer → commençons, commençais)
stem ends in g and the ending starts with a or o (manger → mangeons, mangeais)
stem ends in y before a mute e (nettoyer → nettoie, nettoierai); for -ayer verbs the y spelling (paye) is also accepted
e in the last stem syllable becomes è before a mute e (acheter → achète, achèterai, lever → lève)
é in the last stem syllable becomes è before a mute e in the present/subjunctive boot (préférer → préfère); the futur keeps é
-eler/-eter double the consonant before a mute e (appeler → appelle, jeter → jetterai), except the è verbs above
